title: Integer to Roman Numeral
description: Convert an integer from 1 through 3999 to its canonical Roman numeral representation. Use subtractive forms such as `IV`, `IX`, `XL`, `XC`, `CD`, and `CM` where needed. Input: integer `num`. Output: its Roman numeral string.
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
